name: New Systems Overview.pdf
content: New systems overview for Model 1. Includes the initial part specification, ownership, interface requirements, validation checkpoints, and QA review expectations.

name: Part Approval Checklist.pdf
content: Part approval checklist for Model 1. QA verifies dimensional results, material certificates, test evidence, open deviations, and engineering sign-off before approval.

name: New Part Design Review.pdf
content: Design review record for new Model 1 parts. Covers drawing maturity, tolerance stack, DFMEA actions, interface risks, validation status, and QA observations.

name: Model 2 New Parts Register.pdf
content: Register of new Model 2 parts with part names, drawing references, suppliers, maturity status, planned inspection dates, and QA ownership.

name: Model 3 Approval Status.pdf
content: Approval status for Model 3 parts, including accepted submissions, conditional approvals, rejected evidence, and pending QA actions.

name: Model 4 Design Review Actions.pdf
content: Open and closed design review actions for Model 4, with QA comments, responsible engineering owners, due dates, and evidence requirements.
